original_test_intent: Verify each required retimer management sensor against the exact retimer instance and upstream/downstream link path, reconciling identity and readings across IB SDR/Sensor List, OOB SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web with the specification.
original_method: Freeze the CPU/GPU/root-port, retimer, lane group and downstream endpoint topology; map each retimer instance to stable records; retain complete IB/OOB inventories and Web pages at aligned times; compare typed readings/states/thresholds and correlate passive negotiated link and error health.
manual_activity: The platform owner maps every retimer and link segment, supplies the sensor spec and resolves criteria 3–18; an operator verifies complete Web evidence and the owner decides the result.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/BIOS and each retimer part/serial/firmware/bus identity
Upstream root-port and downstream endpoint, lane group, width/speed and physical location map
Authoritative retimer sensor spec and per-instance IB/OOB/Web mapping
Secure access, complete Web capture and aligned sampling/cache/rounding rules
Passive PCIe/fabric link and error baseline
safety_requirements: Keep the row passive; do not reset, retrain, reconfigure or update retimers or links
Protect credentials and retain full raw inventories before filtering
Map every sensor to an exact retimer and link segment; reject the test title as a sensor name
Do not truncate or clear BMC/host/PCIe/fabric logs
Stop on ambiguous mapping, stale/missing/duplicate sensor, link degradation, new errors or thermal alarm
agent_execution_scope: Verify unique source identity and collect complete read-only IB/OOB inventories
Apply approved retimer-to-link-to-record mappings and normalize fields
Correlate passive negotiated width/speed, errors and thermal state and prepare Web parity
Report missing, extra, duplicate, stale and mismatched records
Perform no reset/retrain/write, criteria invention or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve retimer topology, sensor mapping and expected semantics
Resolve the criteria-number gap and any omitted retimer checks
Review all instances and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool is relevant, but `sensor get 'Sensor Check - RETIMER'` invents a record and OOB-only/truncated data omits IB, Web and link-path completeness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely retain full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, select every owner-mapped retimer record, capture all Web rows and correlate passive per-link health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IB/OOB lists, RETIMER view, Web, SPEC comparison, Config-Check and 3/0-minute values remain; no log clear.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Join each physical retimer and lane segment to stable management records and compare complete IB/OOB/Web evidence with passive link/error context.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds link-path attribution and per-instance completeness without active retraining.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One generic sensor cannot prove multiple retimers or distinguish upstream/downstream paths, and a nominal temperature may coexist with degraded links.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Topology and names may vary by board routing and firmware; mappings must be versioned.

project_override_considerations: Aggregate sensors need explicit instance coverage. Unpopulated paths require N/A rules. This row does not authorize margining, reset or firmware operations.
expected_evidence: Per-retimer physical, bus, firmware, upstream/downstream and lane/link map plus sensor spec
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists with timestamps/exits
Complete Web evidence bound to each retimer instance
Passive link width/speed/error/thermal context, criteria 3–18 decision, no-write/no-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master criteria jump from 2 to 19; DeepSeek invents a title sensor and omits full IB/Web/link-path coverage. Stated retimer coverage is preserved and undefined criteria are escalated.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive retimer objective is clear; topology/spec/mapping and criteria clarification are supplyable inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2017 Wistron-BMC-01037-V002: confirm whether Criteria numbering 1, 2, 19 is only a numbering typo or whether retimer Criteria 3–18 are missing; if missing, provide exact per-retimer/upstream/downstream link sensor coverage, expected values/states and IB/OOB/Web acceptance mapping.

review_improvement: Replaces the generic title query with per-retimer link-path traceability and makes the sixteen-number criteria gap explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: Retimers are directional components embedded in specific link paths; identical sensor labels can refer to distinct devices and thermal conditions. Without upstream/downstream and lane mapping, evidence can be assigned to the wrong path. A healthy temperature also cannot prove negotiated link health, so passive link/error context is needed. Active retraining is outside this row, and criteria 3–18 cannot be inferred.
